scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: A good expedition team needs all kinds of people: brave ones, careful ones, funny ones… and one who brings snacks!
scene.intro: A good expedition team needs all kinds of people, says Ingrid. Maya is clever and quiet, and she notices everything. Diego is friendly and never stops talking, which is useful in an interview. Oliver is brave on a stage and afraid of spiders. And Kili? Kili is not lazy — he is 'saving energy'. What are YOUR friends like? Describe their personality, not their face!

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the personality words.

words.clue: This person smiles and talks to everybody.
This person learns fast and has good ideas.
This person is not afraid of difficult things.
This person never wants to work or help!
This person always says please and thank you.
This person doesn't talk much or make noise.

activities.title: Match the person with the adjective.

pairs.left: She helped a lost little boy find his mum.
He climbed the tree to rescue the cat.
She always checks her work twice.
He tells jokes that make everyone laugh.
He stayed on the sofa all Sunday.
They shout and play loud music at night.

activities.title: Listen. Ingrid describes her team. Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Ingrid: Every explorer in my team is special, Maya. … Ingrid: Diego is the bravest — he interviewed a shark once. From a boat, but still! … Ingrid: Oliver is the funniest. His jokes are terrible, and that's why we laugh. … Ingrid: You are the most careful — you check the map three times before we go. … Maya: Four times, actually. … Ingrid: And Kili is the kindest. He shares his biscuits with the small birds. … Maya: And you, captain? … Ingrid: Me? I'm the loudest when we win!

activities.title: A and B are not the same. Find out why!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the school entrance? The girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket. … Maya: That is Ingrid. Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass? … Maya: That is Maya. Look, Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the girl with a red ponytail and freckles? … Maya: That is Iris. Look, Iris is drawing with chalk on the ground. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey.
data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (nino, reportero) pregunta y Maya (nina, cientifica) responde.
